evidence: The Haryana Space Applications Centre's EODB cadastral map service publishes one layer per district of khasra parcels keyed by district, tehsil, village, murabba and khasra number (uq).
ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals lists HSAC as the original source of its Haryana cadastral release; the Panipat layer was read live on 2026-10-13.

descriptor.name: HSAC Haryana cadastral map — Panipat district
descriptor.scope: Khasra (field) parcels of Panipat district on the Haryana Space Applications Centre's cadastral map, keyed by district, tehsil, village, murabba and khasra number. Unnumbered (khasra 0) polygons are excluded: they cover village settlements and urban cores that the field survey does not divide, so older town centres show no parcels.
descriptor.attribution: Haryana Space Applications Centre (HSAC) — cadastral (khasra) map. Adapted to WGS84.
descriptor.licenceNote: No reuse licence is stated on the public HSAC map service.
caveats: Rural field-survey parcels: not proof of current title or ownership.
The uq key joins district, tehsil, village, murabba and khasra codes; OBJECTID is a transport field.
A khasra can be published as several adjacent pieces under one key; they are joined into one parcel, and overlapping pieces are rejected.
Found through ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals (github.com/ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals), which lists HSAC as an original source; the map is read live from HSAC.
The service answers browsers directly (CORS allows this site); no relay is used.
